About Checkr

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, Amazon, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented AI Conversation Designer to join our Service Design team. This role is central to managing and optimizing our conversational AI agents across multiple modalities, directly impacting customer experience and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with conversational AI platforms, a strong understanding of conversation design principles, and the ability to analyze performance data to drive continuous improvement. This role requires someone who is curious, adaptable, and passionate about leveraging AI to deliver seamless, human-centered support experiences.

· Lead the development, optimization, and ongoing management of conversational AI agents across modalities, ensuring consistent performance and user experience.

· Own the end-to-end lifecycle of assigned AI agents, including prompt engineering, conversation design, testing, and deployment.

· Drive measurable improvements in agent performance through analysis of key performance indicators and conversation analytics.

· Partner with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities and implement solutions that reduce contact volume while maintaining service quality.

· Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for AI agent workflows and processes.

· Monitor and troubleshoot AI agent behavior, diagnosing issues across conversation flows and escalating technical issues as needed.

· Implement and iterate on dynamic response content, including conditional logic, personalization, and multimedia elements within conversational interfaces.

· Lead special projects as required to support evolving AI capabilities and business needs.

· 3-5 years of experience in conversational AI, knowledge management, chatbot administration, or similar roles managing customer-facing digital channels.

· Hands-on experience with conversational AI platforms and understanding of NLU/NLP concepts.

· Proficiency in conversation design principles, including intent mapping, utterance training, and fallback strategies.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret conversation logs, performance dashboards, and customer feedback to drive optimization.

· Excellent written communication skills and ability to craft clear, concise bot responses for diverse audiences.

· Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and translate business requirements into actionable solutions.

· Comfort navigating ambiguity and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

· An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website .

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr

Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance .

Applicant Privacy Policy

If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

60b4c8b05c.t:
Come shape the conversational experiences at the heart of Spotify's AI-driven products. You'll design how people talk with Spotify — the flows, the voice, the moment-to-moment interactions that make AI feel natural, useful, and unmistakably Spotify.
This role sits at the intersection of writing and system design. You'll bring sharp editorial instincts and real writing chops, but you'll spend your time designing how conversations work — not producing UI copy. Whether you come from editorial, linguistics, interaction design, or an engineering background with a strong feel for language, you'll have room to experiment, prototype, and define how the next generation of Spotify products talk back.

Design end-to-end conversational experiences — dialogue flows, turn-taking, state and context handling, error and recovery paths, and multi-turn interactions across Spotify's AI products.

Engineer and refine the prompts that drive generative and conversational features, shaping model behavior to produce accurate, reliable, and useful outputs.

Translate product requirements into conversational system design — identifying the capabilities (tools, data, actions, UI affordances) a system needs to fulfil user intent, and defining how the model interprets that intent, retains context, and decides what to do.

Prototype with large language models to probe model behaviors, constraints, and failure modes, and turn what you learn into more capable experiences.

Build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve conversation quality, accuracy, task completion, and user impact.

Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, designers, and the content design team to bring AI systems into cohesive, human-centered products.

Define guardrails for safe, reliable model behavior across AI-driven interactions.

Help raise the bar for conversation design craft on the team, guiding peers and contributing to shared patterns, evaluation methods, and documentation.

Technically capable — comfortable working directly with LLMs and code, writing and running evaluations, using structured formats (JSON, YAML, Python), and diagnosing whether a failure is a prompt problem, a system design problem, or a missing capability.

Practiced at testing and improving conversational systems or prompts through data, feedback, and experimentation.

Energized by ambiguity, creativity, and the challenge of defining new interaction paradigms in a fast-moving AI landscape.

A strong writer and editor with excellent editorial judgment, and a distinct feel for voice and character design — how a system's personality is expressed through prompting and behavior, not just word choice.

A strong cross-functional collaborator who balances technical possibility with creative vision.

Familiar with accessibility, localization, regulatory compliance, and safety in digital experiences.

About Decagon
Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.
Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.
We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.
We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

Over the past few years, development of LLMs has evolved at a rapid pace. It’s not enough for our customers to just “set it and forget it” when it comes to AI software. Truly successful AI Agents require guidance and input throughout the development lifecycle.

As part of the Conversation Design team, you'll help shape what great AI conversation experiences look and sound like — across channels and languages, for enterprise customers around the world. You'll work directly with customers and internal teams to improve agent quality — especially in voice, one of our fastest growing channels — and build the systems and resources that allow us to scale your expertise.
This work spans research, design, enablement, and product strategy. You might:
Advise customers and internal teams on conversation design and voice selection
Evaluate and iterate on voice quality across providers, languages, and use cases
Build playbooks, rubrics, and evaluation frameworks that scale best practices across the team
Partner with Engineering and Product to translate field insights into platform improvements
Your insights will shape how Decagon deploys AI in mission-critical contexts and how we build toward the next generation of intelligent systems.
In this role, you will
Design and optimize enterprise-grade AI conversation experiences across chat, voice, SMS, and email channels
Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on conversation design best practices
Evaluate voice quality and interaction patterns to maintain a high bar for naturalness and appropriateness
Build repeatable frameworks for assessing conversation and voice performance
Enable our Customer team to apply strong design judgment independently
Partner crossfunctionally with Engineering and Product to investigate quality gaps and drive improvements through clear recommendations
Share learnings and create documentation on best practices to improve consistency and raise the quality bar across deployments
Your background looks something like this
5+ years of relevant experience (e.g., voice experience design, conversation designer, product manager, applied linguistics, etc.)
Hands-on experience with voice — conversational AI, speech synthesis, or audio production
Experience migrating NLU systems to LLM and understanding key use cases for RAG functionality improvements
Experience building evaluation frameworks, rubrics, or QA processes
Strong communicator across technical and business contexts
Comfortable working close to the product in a fast-moving environment
Even better if you have
Native or professional fluency in Spanish and/or familiarity with other languages
Experience with TTS providers or speech synthesis tools
Hands-on experience with frontier AI tools and deployment in enterprise or high-impact settings

Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)
